title: ChatGPT Plus Price in India 2026: Rs 1,999 and How to Save
text:
ChatGPT Plus costs Rs 1,999 a month in India including GST. Here is how UPI, GST and card fees work, what Plus includes now, and legitimate ways to pay less.

...

ChatGPT Plus costs Rs 1,999 per month in India, including 18% GST, when you pay in rupees, according to OpenAI’s rupee pricing as reported at launch and current app store price trackers. That is the rupee version of the $20 US price. The cheapest official way to pay is in INR by UPI or an Indian card on chatgpt.com, which avoids foreign exchange markups. If Rs 1,999 is too much, ChatGPT Go at Rs 399 per month or the free plan (now on GPT-6 Luna) may be enough.

...

## Key takeaways

- ChatGPT Plus is Rs 1,999 per month in India including GST (about Rs 1,694 before tax). In the US it is $20 per month.
- OpenAI supports UPI in India, but only for Go and Plus. Pro and Business need a card.
- ChatGPT Go costs Rs 399 per month and runs GPT-6 Luna; Free also runs GPT-6 Luna with fewer extras.
- Plus now includes GPT-6 Sol in Chat and GPT-6 Astra inside ChatGPT Work and Codex.
- Avoid cheap “shared Plus” resellers: they break OpenAI’s terms and put your data at risk.

...

## ChatGPT prices in India at a glance

OpenAI bills India in rupees and lists India as a local currency country in its official payment methods help article. It does not print INR prices in its help center, so the rupee figures below come from OpenAI’s India launch announcements as reported in the press and from app store listings. We could not read them on an official OpenAI page, so confirm the price at checkout.

| Plan | India price | US price | UPI allowed | Main model |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Free | Rs 0 | $0 | Not needed | GPT-6 Luna |
| Go | Rs 399/month | $8/month | Yes | GPT-6 Luna |
| Plus | Rs 1,999/month (incl. GST) | $20/month | Yes | GPT-6 Sol |
| Pro | Rs 19,900/month reported for the old single tier; current tier prices not confirmed | $100, $200 or $500/month | No | GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Pro on Astra |
| Business | No INR price published; check at checkout | $25/user/month ($20 annual) | No | GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Pro |

For what each plan includes in detail, see our full ChatGPT pricing guide.

...

Plus is the plan most Indian professionals end up on, and it got stronger in October 2026. Since 7 October, Plus users chat with GPT-6 Sol at three thinking levels: Instant, Medium and High. Plus also includes GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI’s flagship model, inside ChatGPT Work and Codex. Our explainer on GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna covers the differences.

- Expanded messages and uploads compared with Free and Go.
- Intelligent UI answers with charts, buttons and small tools (also on Free and Go).
- ChatGPT Work for multi-step tasks and finished files, plus Codex for coding.
- Deep research, more complex image creation, projects, scheduled tasks and voice.
- Early access to new features and no ads (OpenAI is testing ads on Free and Go in the US).

Plus does not include the Extra High or Pro thinking levels, and OpenAI warns that Plus may still hit message caps at busy times. Our guide to ChatGPT limits by plan explains how those work.

...

## How GST and card fees change what you pay

The Rs 1,999 Plus price is reported to include 18% GST. Working backwards, Rs 1,999 divided by 1.18 is about Rs 1,694 before tax, and the GST portion is about Rs 305. If you are a GST-registered business, ask your accountant whether you can claim input tax credit, and make sure your invoice shows the right details.

Paying the US price of $20 on an international card works differently. Your bank converts the amount at its own exchange rate and usually adds a foreign transaction markup of a few percent, plus GST on that markup. The final rupee amount can change month to month with the exchange rate. That is why paying in rupees is usually simpler and more predictable.

Watch out: Existing subscribers keep their current billing currency. OpenAI says that to switch to INR you must cancel and re-subscribe after your current billing period ends. Do not cancel mid-cycle or you may lose the remaining days.

## How to pay for ChatGPT Plus in India

OpenAI’s help center lists these options for India:

- Credit and debit cards work in all countries, including Indian Visa, Mastercard and RuPay cards that allow online or recurring payments.
- UPI is available in India for Go and Plus only. Pro and Business are excluded.
- Apple App Store and Google Play subscriptions are billed by Apple or Google in local currency and managed in your phone’s subscription settings.

### Step by step: subscribe to Plus with UPI

1. Open ChatGPT on the web. Go to chatgpt.com in a browser and sign in. Web checkout gives you the UPI option and keeps the subscription with OpenAI rather than an app store.
2. Choose Upgrade plan. Open the menu from your profile and select the option to upgrade. Pick Plus from the list of plans.
3. Check the price is in rupees. The checkout should show the INR amount. If you see USD, you may be on an older subscription currency or signed in from a different region.
4. Select UPI and approve the mandate. Enter your UPI ID or scan the code, then approve the recurring payment request in your UPI app (such as Google Pay, PhonePe or Paytm).
5. Save the invoice. Download the receipt from your account settings for your records or GST claims.

Tip: Set a calendar reminder two days before renewal. UPI autopay mandates can fail if your bank’s limit or the mandate itself has expired, and ChatGPT will drop you back to Free until payment goes through.

...

### 1. Pay in rupees, not dollars

Paying Rs 1,999 in INR avoids foreign exchange markup and conversion swings. It is the simplest saving and needs no trade-offs.

### 2. Start with Go at Rs 399

Go costs about a fifth of Plus. It runs GPT-6 Luna with “Think,” and gives higher limits than Free for images, uploads and data analysis, plus longer memory, projects and tasks. It does not include GPT-6 Sol or Pro models, and third-party sources say agent-style features and full deep research are missing. For students and light users, Go is often enough.

...

## Is there an annual ChatGPT Plus plan in India?

OpenAI has not confirmed an annual Plus price, in India or the US. Twelve months at Rs 1,999 comes to Rs 23,988 per year. By comparison, Claude Pro has an official annual option in USD ($17 per month billed yearly). If annual billing matters to you, read our annual vs monthly AI plans guide before committing anywhere.

...

In November 2025 OpenAI announced 12 months of ChatGPT Go free for users in India, with a Re 1 UPI or Rs 2 card verification charge. Third-party price trackers say that launch promotion has ended, and OpenAI’s India promotion page showed no active terms when last checked.

...

### What is the ChatGPT Plus price in India?

ChatGPT Plus costs Rs 1,999 per month in India, including 18% GST, when billed in rupees. That is about Rs 1,694 before tax. If you pay the $20 US price on an international card, your bank converts it and may add a foreign transaction fee, so the rupee amount varies. OpenAI’s help center does not list INR prices, so confirm at checkout.

...

## Verdict: the cheapest smart way to get ChatGPT Plus in India

Pay Rs 1,999 a month in rupees by UPI on chatgpt.com if you use ChatGPT for work most days. It is the cleanest, cheapest official route, with no forex markup and a proper invoice. If you are a student or light user, start with Free or Go at Rs 399, and only upgrade when you keep hitting limits. Skip shared-account resellers entirely. OpenAI has not published INR prices in its help center and changes plans often, so confirm the current price at checkout or on the official ChatGPT pricing page before you subscribe.

title: ChatGPT Plus and Pro plans for India: Here’s what has changed | Technology News - The Indian Express
text:
OpenAI has updated the way it displays subscription prices for ChatGPT Plus and Pro plans in India. While it may look like the company has raised rates, the actual cost for users remains unchanged.

Earlier, Indian ChatGPT users saw prices in US dollars: $20 for Plus and $200 for Pro. However, these were tax-exclusive sticker prices, meaning subscribers paid more once GST was added. For example, a Plus plan effectively cost $23.60 with GST included.

Now, OpenAI lists the subscription prices directly in Indian Rupees, inclusive of GST for individual plans:

ChatGPT Plus: Rs 1,999/month (inclusive of GST) — unchanged from launch on mobile ChatGPT Pro: Rs 19,900/year (inclusive of GST) — unchanged from launch on mobile ChatGPT Team: Rs 2,599/month per user (exclusive of GST)

This adjustment makes pricing clearer and consistent with how subscriptions are usually presented in India, but it doesn’t increase what customers actually pay.

title: ChatGPT Plus Is Free for One Month in India: Here’s How to Claim It | Technology News
text:
The free ChatGPT Plus offer can be claimed directly through the ChatGPT subscription page.

 Written by Shaurya Tomer, Edited by Rohan Pal | Updated: 5 October 2026 16:22 IST 

Photo Credit: Unsplash/ Solen Feyissa

The availability of the promotion appears to be account-specific

Highlights

- The limited-time trial drops the monthly fee from Rs. 1,999 to Rs. 0 
- Users must provide valid payment details to activate the free trial 
- Subscriptions auto-renew at Rs. 1,999 per month after the trial ends

OpenAI is offering a limited-time free trial of its ChatGPT Plus subscription in India. With this move, the San Francisco-based AI company is providing eligible users with access to the paid tier of the AI chatbot without the usual monthly charge. The offer is currently visible to select users and provides one month of the ChatGPT Plus plan at no cost. However, the promotion does not appear to be available to every account.

## How to Claim Free ChatGPT Plus for One Month

The free ChatGPT Plus offer can be claimed directly through the ChatGPT subscription page. Eligible users should see a “Claim free offer” button under the ChatGPT Plus plan. The offer page shows the regular Rs. 1,999 monthly price crossed out, with the subscription price reduced to Rs. 0 for the promotional period.

To claim the offer, sign in to ChatGPT using the account on which the promotion is available. Open the subscription or upgrade page and look for the ChatGPT Plus card. If the account is eligible, the Plus plan should show the limited-time free offer instead of the standard Rs. 1,999 monthly price. Click the “Claim free offer” button to proceed.

You will then be taken through the regular subscription checkout process. OpenAI requires users taking part in free ChatGPT Plus trials to provide payment information. They can use options like cards or net banking. There is also a UPI option, although Gadgets 360 staff were not able to avail of the plan using the payment method on multiple occasions.

The availability of the promotion appears to be account-specific. In our testing, the free offer was visible on an account that had not previously subscribed to any ChatGPT paid plan. On another account that had previously subscribed to ChatGPT Go, the free Plus offer was not shown, and the standard Rs. 1,999 monthly price was displayed instead.

This essentially means that if the Plus card shows Rs. 1,999 rather than the Rs. 0 promotional price, the offer may not be available for that particular account.

It is also worth checking the subscription renewal terms. Since the promotion is for the first month, the subscription can revert to the regular Rs. 1,999 monthly price after the trial period. This means users who do not want to continue with ChatGPT Plus should cancel the subscription before the free period ends. Alternatively, they can cancel the automatic renewal mandate if set up.

### ChatGPT Plus के क्या लाभ हैं?

ChatGPT Plus में एडवांस्ड मॉडल्स, Thinking के साथ इमेज बनाने की सुविधा, ज़्यादा मेमोरी और डीप रिसर्च, ChatGPT वर्क, Codex, प्रोजेक्ट्स और कस्टम GPT मिलते हैं.

### ChatGPT Plus Free प्लॉन से किस प्रकार भिन्न है?

Plus में बेहतर रीज़निंग, ChatGPT वर्क और Codex का ज़्यादा एक्सेस, बेहतर इमेज बनाने की सुविधा और रिसर्च व फ़ाइलें अपलोड करने की बेहतर लिमिट्स मिलती हैं.

### क्या ChatGPT Plus का उपयोग करना सुरक्षित है?

title: ChatGPT ads in India, OpenAI starts notifying users about rollout
text: Industry Odisha Bureau, Aug 13: In latest news, OpenAI is expanding ads on ChatGPT to more markets, and India appears to be among the next countries to see them. Some users in India have received emails from OpenAI informing them about changes to the ChatGPT privacy policy and the introduction of ads. The email says ads may appear on the Free and Go plans. ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Enterprise, Business and Education plans will continue to remain ad-free. Notably, the Go plan costs Rs 399 per month in India. Meanwhile, Plus is priced at Rs 1,999 per month. OpenAI has already introduced ads on ChatGPT in the US. The company is now officially expanding the programme to markets including the UK, Mexico, Brazil, Japan and South Korea. Ads are also being tested in Australia, New Zealand and Canada. The most common question that might arise amid this update - Will the ads affect ChatGPT’s answers in any way? To this, OpenAI says that it will not. The company has stated that ads will not influence ChatGPT’s responses. Advertisements will be clearly labelled as “sponsored, and displayed separately from the chatbot’s answers. Further, the company may personalize ads using information available within ChatGPT, such as a user’s interactions with advertisements or relevant chat context. However, OpenAI says advertisers will not have access to the users’ chats, chat history, memories, or personal information. Notably, Advertisers will only receive aggregated performance data. Such as the number of views or clicks that their ads receive. For Indian users, the rollout mean Free and Go subscribers may soon see sponsored content while using ChatGPT, although OpenAI has not yet formally announced the India rollout.
